message: 憧れへの挑戦

name: Ria
message: 「Hello, everyone. I am Ria Kujou, candidate for President of the Ryuusei Student Council.」
That was one year ago.
Ria-senpai stood up on the podium, and I looked up at her from my seat.
The newly appointed Student Council President. That was the exact moment I learned her full name.
Speaking of Kujou―senpai―
She was the daughter of the Kujou family that ran Ryuusei Academy, and possessed an upbringing, refinement, and demeanor that could only be described as that of a true young lady.
Her grades consistently held the top spot, and rumor had it that in athletics, she riveted the gaze of boys and girls alike.
Her dazzling conduct, bordering on absolute perfection, quickly became known throughout the entire academy, making her a popular figure whom everyone envied and revered.
And that very Ria-senpai ran for Student Council President.
Even setting aside the fact that she was a daughter of the Kujou family, her unanimous election was practically inevitable.
At the time, I was still getting used to my part-time job and school life, so things like the Student Council never even crossed my mind, though.
I remember seeing Ria-senpai as Student Council President in person for the first time and being completely overwhelmed by how amazing she was.
Putting aside our backgrounds and upbringings, even her very essence felt worlds apart from mine--
So much so that it felt far, far more distant than the physical space between my seat and the podium.
It didn't feel like we were even attending the same school--I saw her as someone mysterious, standing on a much higher plane.
I used to watch her from afar and admire her.
Wishing I could become someone like Ria-senpai, too.
And then a year passed.
The person I admired is now working hard alongside me on the Student Council as a dependable senpai.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun.」
Sure, I ran for Student Council President because I wanted to enjoy a sparkling academy life.
To me, it looked like Ria-senpai was living a sparkling academy life, and maybe seeing that was what made me decide to run.
It wasn't the entire reason, of course, but it was definitely one of them.

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Synn-kun!」
So I just hope I've managed to become even a little bit like the kind of Student Council President Ria-senpai was.

name: Ria
message: 「Boop.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hngah!」
A soft little finger poked me right in the cheek.

name: Ria
message: 「Looks like everyone already headed out.」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, yeah, right.」

name: Ria
message: 「So, what's up? Spacing out like that... Did you hit a snag with something?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, no. It's not that--」

name: Ria
message: 「Aha! You were thinking about something else entirely, weren't you~~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp」

name: Ria
message: 「Heeey. There's no time to be spacing out, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Urk... I'm sorry」

name: Ria
message: 「Instead of apologizing, first get your head, hands, and body moving!」
If she can see right through me like this, I still have a long way to go before I can match up to Ria-senpai.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's do this!」
I spread a blank A3 sheet of paper out on the desk.

name: Ria
message: 「What are we doing?」

name: Synn
message: 「I was thinking we could decide on the exhibitor layout. Here's the current list of people from the shopping district who want to participate」

name: Ria
message: 「What about the student applicants?」

name: Synn
message: 「They're on a separate sheet」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, you separated them neatly」

name: Synn
message: 「It's easier to understand that way, after all」

name: Ria
message: 「And we'll make a layout map based on this, right」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. And from there, I'm hoping we can carry it all the way to making the guide map for the pamphlet」

name: Ria
message: 「Mm-hmm, sounds good. Knowing where each kind of shop is located is super convenient, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Should we take a walk around first to see how we actually want to set up each area?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah♪」

name: Synn
message: 「The entrance and reception desk will be right here」

name: Ria
message: 「Since it's a special festival, it'd be great if we could build a big arch right here」

name: Synn
message: 「About how big should it be~?」

name: Ria
message: 「Aboooooout this big!」
She stretches her arms out wide as if tracing the air, showing the maximum size she can.

name: Synn
message: 「That big?」

name: Ria
message: 「Did I make it too big?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm itching to get started~」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. Spoken like a true boy. I'm counting on you for the heavy lifting\s04」
Let's work hard together with everyone and make it big enough to blow Senpai away.

name: Synn
message: 「Should we put the reception desk right here?」

name: Ria
message: 「We'll need a tent too」

name: Synn
message: 「I sure hope the weather stays clear」

name: Ria
message: 「We'd better make a teru-teru bozu just in case」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, I know! Pa-chan, why don't you be our teru-teru bozu?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Y-Yours truly, as Ria-chan's terun-terun bozu!?」

name: Ria
message: 「If you put on a white skirt, you'd look the part! I'll even lend you mine」

name: Paqy
message: 「R-Ria-chan's skirt!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wouldn't being hung up all day be a bit……」

name: Paqy
message: 「I can easily put up with that much!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Just kidding♪ Totally joking\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, with your waist, Pa-chan, I bet it'd be way too baggy\s02」

name: Paqy
message: 「I wouldn't be so sure about that. Tell me your three sizes so we can check」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's see――」

name: Ria
message: 「H-Hey~~! That's a secret!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, so close」

name: Synn
message: 「With a figure as great as yours, Senpai, it doesn't seem like you'd have anything to hide」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh……. Y-You really think so?」

name: Ria
message: 「……! Even so! That doesn't make it okay to ask a girl her three sizes, ya know!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm sorry!」

name: Ria
message: 「I hate Pa-chan when he tries to trick people!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gyaaah!!」
He brought that on himself.

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm... Maybe I went a little too far?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's good medicine for him.」

name: Ria
message: 「I see... Well, if Master says so, then that's that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Imagine wanting to know someone's three sizes when you're just a plushie.」

name: Ria
message: 「And what about you, Synn-kun... Don't you want to know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh?」

name: Ria
message: 「Not... interested?」

name: Synn
message: 「If I said I wasn't, that... would... be... a lie.」

name: Synn
message: 「B―But they're just numbers, right?! You can't tell everything from that anyway, ahahahahaha―come on, let's decide the layout, the layout!」

name: Ria
message: 「Phew... I see. Thank goodness~~」
Ria-senpai let out an exaggerated sigh of relief.

name: Ria
message: 「So you really are a boy after all, Synn-kun.」
So that's all I amount to, huh.

name: Ria
message: 「I'm relieved that Synn-kun actually treats me like a girl\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Want me to tell you my sizes in secret?」

name: Ria
message: 「Just kidding. Total lie~」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「Just pulling your leg, hop-hop!」
She holds both hands up like rabbit ears, wiggling her fingers back and forth.

name: Ria
message: 「A-ny-way. What were you going to say after 'No, I--'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nga!」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm super curious~」
I'm always acutely aware of Ria-senpai as a woman, but there's no way I could ever say that out loud!

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not telling!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee」

name: Synn
message: 「Jeez! We don't have time to be messing around like this!」

name: Ria
message: 「Whoa~~. I got scolded♪」
Unlike the dignified senpai I had always seen before, she was a girl acting just like a little devil.
I still admire her just as much as ever, though ever since joining the Student Council, it's been one surprise after another.
Especially when it's just the two of us--she teases me, gets all touchy-feely, and basically does whatever she wants with her underclassman.

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'm sorry...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Did I go a little too far? I didn't mean to...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! No!! The layout. Let's go over it!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-Yeah! Good idea\s01」
Did Senpai get worried because she thought I was actually mad at her?
Since she has cute sides like this too, I really can't let my guard down.

name: Synn
message: 「Since there are plenty of water hookups here, I was thinking of putting the food stalls in this area」

name: Ria
message: 「Like Nanaka-chan's stall and the others, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. The area in front of the school building is spacious, so they should all fit. That'll work great」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, hey. Prier has a kitchen, so couldn't we put it to good use for all sorts of things~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, that's true. Though boiling soba noodles probably requires specialized pots and equipment...」

name: Ria
message: 「Then let's split them up between stalls that can use Prier's kitchen and ones that can't」

name: Synn
message: 「If we do that, we'll end up with leftover space...」

name: Ria
message: 「Then it's better to have the other stalls set up here after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's make sure we space them out evenly」

name: Ria
message: 「And right here, we set up the Kirafes Executive Committee HQ with a 'ta-da~~!'」

name: Synn
message: 「The student recycling entries would probably be better off in the same spot as last year...」

name: Ria
message: 「In that case, spreading everything out right here with a big 'Ta-daaa!' is definitely the best way to go.」

name: Synn
message: 「We've gotten applications for live performances too, so let's put the stage right here with a big 'Ta-daaa!' as well!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ta-daaa♪」

name: Synn
message: 「That about covers it, I think.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ta-daaa♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai...?」

name: Ria
message: 「And one more 'Ta-daaa!' as a bonus!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aha, ahahaha.」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh, what, what? Why are you laughing~~?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's just, Senpai... your whole personality did a complete 180.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ehhh?! That hurts my feelings~~ I don't know what kind of impression you had of me, Synn-kun, but I've always been like this.」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Really... That's unexpected.」

name: Ria
message: 「'Unexpected,' he says. How rude, geez.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no, that side of you. I'm totally fine with it.」

name: Ria
message: 「Then what? How did you see me up until now, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well... you always looked so cool when speaking up on stage, and gave off such a refined, upper-class vibe...」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's not true at all\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「I just thought, wow, she's really mature~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Why is that in the past tense?! Even right now, I'm still more mature than you, Synn-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's only a one-year difference, isn't it?」

name: Ria
message: 「A one-year gap is huge! Not even three thousand years of history could overturn it! Hmph.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sulking like that is the exact opposite of mature, you know.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ugh... I guess so. You're right...」

name: Ria
message: 「Aaaalright! Time to show off my mature composure!」
She puts her hands on her hips and puffs out her chest.

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem. Piece of cake♪」
Naturally, that only accentuates her chest.

name: Ria
message: 「I won't be fooled by what you say anymore, Synn-kun. Now, bring it on!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I already surrender」
Her body is completely that of a grown woman, after all…….

name: Synn
message: 「Phew…… I'm back~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Yes, welcome back. Good work today」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh. Thank you. *Slurp*…… Huh, when did you make tea?」

name: Ria
message: 「In the blink of an 'eye,' you know」

name: Synn
message: 「So fast~」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem. I am your senior, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm a senior to Lolotte too, so do you think I can pull that off?」

name: Ria
message: 「It might be just a tiny bit impossible」
So I'm just one step away, huh.

name: Synn
message: 「Now that the layout is decided, let's make a guide map」
With my memo notebook in one hand, I faced a blank sheet of paper.

name: Synn
message: 「In front of the school building is…… um, where was that again」
I flip through the pages to check.

name: Ria
message: 「Yuugiri-an, Ponpoko, and Shinagawa Produce. All the cake shops we're currently approaching, plus Kindai Antiquarian Books from the other day, go here too, I think」

name: Ria
message: 「Am I missing any?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, not at all」
Every single shop name written in my notebook. And she even filled in ones we hadn't talked about.

name: Synn
message: 「Next is Prier, Prier……」

name: Ria
message: 「Wagashi Club wants to use the kitchen, so could you put them at Prier?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I think that'll be fine」

name: Ria
message: 「Also, if they're using a steamer, put the meat bun shop there too」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean Five-Star Hanten, right」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufu. It was so good that I just remembered them by their meat buns\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「So the layout order goes tap-tap-tap like this」
Following along with my senpai's words, I write down the names of the shops.
Without even needing to look back at our notes, the rough draft came together effortlessly.

name: Ria
message: 「Now we just need to make a clean copy of this and it'll be perfect」
My senpai is already rolling up her sleeves. She's raring to go.

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, if you want to do it, go right ahead」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha, you caught me?」

name: Synn
message: 「By all means, please do. I'll practice brewing tea in the meantime」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufu. Keep the refills coming, okay」

name: Ria
message: 「Mm-hm. That ought to do it」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, is it finished」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go\s04」
At that moment, the word "shogunate" popped into my head.
Drawn on the paper was the kind of illustration I'd seen in history textbooks.

name: Synn
message: 「Is this ukiyo-e……?」
Spread out before me were the Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido.
The guide's text was even painstakingly written horizontally from right to left, using archaic hiragana spellings.
This would certainly be friendly to the elderly.
Even so, I can't help thinking it's a bit too hard to understand…….

name: Ria
message: 「It kind of looks like a map, so it's nice, right\s07」
Yet Ria-senpai flashed a smile brimming with confidence.
Well, I suppose we can make this work in its own way…….

name: Synn
message: 「This sure is unique」

name: Ria
message: 「Maybe it would've been better to give it a bit more of a festival vibe」

name: Synn
message: 「How would that change things?」

name: Ria
message: 「I think it'd feel way, way more fun, though it might end up a little too busy~」
I could never imitate Ria-senpai's artistic style. Serving tea is all I can handle.
Anyway, the pamphlet map is finished!
